name: 梁斯寧
objective: This course aims to develop students' English language skills and communicative competence for effective communication. Centered around the fields of science, technology and engineering, the materials and activities in the course are designed to prepare students to understand and discuss the topics of the fields.

materials:
Kenny, S., Sabatino, E., & Bondar, J. (2022). Capstone: English for Information and New Technology. Taipei: Crane Publishing.

This is an English for Specific/Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All textbooks, teaching materials, handouts, and presentation slides are in English. English is used for at least 90% of classroom instruction and teacher–student interaction.
本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 90% (含) 以上。

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）
課程是否導入AI: ● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
